description: The single manifest of identifiers shared between the desktop clients, the Jazz processor and its web app. Every value here is what the clients actually emit or read today; 'legacy' lists the pre-rename (Jasnost) spellings a reader must still accept. macOS, Windows and the processor each run a parity test against this file, so renaming a listed identifier on one side fails that side's CI.

schemaIdBase.note: Base of every top-level payload schema $id in contract/schema/ and of the payloadSchema an archive record names. Nested contract families use their own bases under https://jazz.dev/ (archive/, enrollment/, live/).

capture.note: Kind tag the macOS client stamps first on narration audio and on liveCompatibility artifact projections.

archiveArtifact.note: macOS liveCompatibility artifact projection (screenshots and other archive artifacts), next to kind:<kind>.

narration.note: macOS narration audio (with jazz, session:<id>, label:<id>).

screenshot.note: Windows screenshot artifact kind tag (the first tag of the Files prepare call).

narrationAudio.note: Windows narration audio artifact kind tag (the first tag of the Files prepare call).

areaRegistry.note: The Data App's per-Area registry document, read by the macOS Files fallback with area:<areaId>.

serviceName.note: Resource service.name of every capture source.

scopeName.note: Instrumentation scope name; informational, not part of the SQL contract.

handler.note: window.webkit.messageHandlers.<handler>: the web-to-native channel the macOS WebCanvas registers.

bdmSegmentHook.note: window.<hook>(segment): the native-to-web function the live BDM page installs and BdmLiveBridge calls.
